name: 记账·查账明细
description: 查询支出明细并组装为 show_table 表格结构（终点输出可直接透传 show_table 工具）。inputs：month 月份 yyyy-MM（空串=不限月份）、limit 最近 N 笔（空串=5，钳 0..200）。merge 模板直嵌 database 行集 JSON 组装（零 code 节点——打包态不依赖系统 node 解释器）。

nodes.name: 查明细行集
nodes.sql: SELECT spent_at, category, amount, note FROM expense WHERE (? = '' OR strftime('%Y-%m', spent_at) = ?) ORDER BY spent_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT MAX(0, MIN(CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), '5') AS INTEGER), 200))

nodes.name: 组装表格结构
nodes.template: {"title":"支出明细","columns":[{"key":"spent_at","label":"日期"},{"key":"category","label":"类别"},{"key":"amount","label":"金额"},{"key":"note","label":"备注"}],"rows":{{nodes.select-expenses.output}}}
